fields.name: UserId
fields.description: IAM user id that owns this drive setup record -- one record per user.

fields.name: DirectoryName
fields.description: Sanitized display-name + user-id composite used as this user's drive root folder name in Blocks Storage.

fields.name: DirectoryId
fields.description: Blocks Storage directory id for this user's drive root. Empty until the folder is successfully created.
